q: Are your cans original and sealed?
a: Yes. Every can is sourced from authorised distributors and importers, arrives factory-sealed and carries a best-before date on the base. We check each can for dents before packing.
Orders inside Dhaka usually arrive within 1–2 working days. Other divisions take 3–5 working days. Orders placed before 3:00 PM are processed the same day.

q: Which payment methods do you accept?
a: Cash on delivery, bKash, Nagad and Rocket. For mobile payments, send the amount to our merchant number and enter the transaction ID at checkout — we verify and confirm your order.
Delivery is free on orders above ৳1,500. Below that it is ৳60 inside Dhaka and ৳120 for the rest of Bangladesh. Some coupons also unlock free delivery.

q: What if a can arrives dented or leaking?
a: Message us within 24 hours with a photo and your order number. We will replace the can or refund the amount — no arguments.

q: Can I buy cartons in bulk for an event?
a: Absolutely. Choose the 24-can carton on any product page, or contact us for large corporate and event orders and special pricing.
